DISTRICT 9 - CGD-GL MSI/General/Miscellaneous

The Coast Guard has transitioned to a visual Maritime Safety Information Products application for the transmission of relevant information previously contained in the published Local Notice to Mariners and Coast Guard Light List. The application, which is accessible at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/msi, contains the most up to date maritime information overlayed on nautical charts and plotted using latitude and longitude. While the ability to print Local Notice to Mariners and Light List copies is still temporarily available, these printed products lack the positional accuracy of the electronic application and can therefore lead to relevant information being overlooked. Mariners are strongly encouraged to use the Maritime Safety Information Products application as their primary source for all information previously contained in the Local Notic

Mariners are advised to stay clear of the quoin on miter gate #4 on the upstream end of the I-Wall at L/D Nr. 3, in the vicinity of Mile 796.9.  There is potential to contact exposed steel in the area.  All tows transitioning the lock should avoid landing or rubbing on the portion of the I-Wall.  Mariners may contact L/D Nr. 3 via VHF-FM Channel 14, or at (651) 290-5062, for additional information.
